verdicts.reason: A: the Shop button is pushed almost flush against the right edge (about 4px margin) and the logo sits close to the left edge, so the margins are uneven. The headline is also pulled left, which leaves a large dead gap before the CTA. B keeps the original's left-to-right rhythm with even margins of about 28px on both sides and a properly sized CTA. Its headline sits slightly off-centre between the logo and the button, and the spacing is a bit loose, but that only needs minor polish.
